response.sql:
WITH color_counts AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(p.product_color, 'No Color') AS color,
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(19, 4)) AS count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.product_color, 'No Color')
),
color_stats AS (
  SELECT color, count,
    count / SUM(count) OVER () AS share,
    AVG(count) OVER () AS avg_count
  FROM color_counts
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT count, share, avg_count,
    count - avg_count AS excess
  FROM color_stats
  WHERE count > avg_count
)
SELECT AVG(count) AS average_count,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG(excess) AS average_excess
FROM filtered;

assumptions.assumption: Products with NULL product_color are grouped as a distinct group and represented as 'No Color' in the output.

alternatives.interpretation: Products with NULL product_color are shown as NULL in the grouping, rather than converted to a 'No Color' label. Logically identical, different output representation.
